children: ICICI Securities research report on Hindustan Unilever

HUL's analyst day theme was WINI - Winning In New India. For context, HUL had unveiled WIMI -Winning In Many India in 2014. Highlights - (1) increased capex plans to 3% of revenues from 2% (improved volume-led growth assumption plus spends for cost, efficiency improvements), (2) granular strategy about 24 consumer-channel combinations, (3) growth-driver mix - 40% from higher consumption and premiumisation, 40% from market making, 20% from new spaces, (4) we liked the clear focus on crafting "desirable brands", (5) operating margin guidance tweaked to 22-24% from 22.5-23.5%. Retain BUY. Continued sector derating appears the material headwind for stock outperformance.

We maintain our estimates, modelling revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR of 11/11/11 (%) over FY26–28E. Retain BUY with a DCF-based unchanged target price of INR 2,700. At our target price, the stock would trade at 49x P/E Mar’28E.
